entities.name: Jesse Ylönen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jesse Ylönen is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a winger for Djurgårdens IF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He was selected in the second round, 35th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2018 NHL entry draft. Ylönen holds dual citizenship of Finland and the United States.
